Runner: invariants-5 and specified-3 logs show every tests/test_synth_case.py test PASSED, plus the byte-identical tests in the full suite (2810 passed).

_p11_pairs (tests/test_synth_case.py:68-86) checks one debit and one credit of equal size in different accounts, each naming the other, no line in two pairs, against categorise.pair_own_accounts (src/cma/categorise.py:1471-1520). Run on generated two-account cases at the default config. All PASSED in the runner's invariants log. The evals (behavioural-6) report 9/9 featured cases matching truth.

findings.claim: The case truth's own-account pairs assume firm.DEFAULT_PAIRING_DAYS (3). The case that `cma generate --case` makes is paired with CMA_HOME's firm.yaml own_account_pairing_days (overrides.py:400, valid range 0-31, firm.py:281). Under a non-default setting the truth written to *.truth.json ('case'.own_account_pairs, category_by_id, buckets, outside_money_in) no longer matches the case the same command made. The truth file does not record the pairing days it assumed, and the command gives no warning.
findings.repro: Write own_account_pairing_days: 31 to firm.yaml under CMA_HOME, then run `cma generate --archetype cafe --profile good --feature all --case --out /tmp/x`. The -1000 moves fall on the 19th of each month, about 30-31 days apart, so each reserve +1000 credit is a candidate for the neighbouring months' move debits too. pair_own_accounts (categorise.py:1506-1518) pairs none of them and lists them in the judgement queue, while truth['case']['own_account_pairs'] still lists every move. A smaller window, such as 7, already lets a ~£1,000 supplier DD (LANTERN ENERGY 807-1092, ROADLINE FUEL CARD 833-1127) 4-7 days from a move break a pair the truth claims. Fix: generate with the firm's pairing days, or record the days in the truth and warn or refuse when they differ.
